body_markdown:
**KANSAS CITY – Nov. 20, 2026** – Frontier Airlines (


[Nasdaq: ULCC](https://ir.flyfrontier.com/) ) launched new, nonstop service today from Kansas City International Airport (MCI) to Orlando International Airport in Florida (MCO). The new route, operating four times per week, builds on Frontier’s commitment to offer high-value travel options to more consumers in more places. To celebrate, Frontier is offering fares starting at $99.*


“We are pleased to launch this new route at MCI, offering high-value travel to consumers visiting Central Florida’s world-class attractions or any of the other exciting domestic and international destinations we serve beyond,” said Josh Flyr, vice president of network and operations design, Frontier Airlines. “We are simultaneously adding destinations to our network that consumers are seeking while reimagining their onboard experience, implementing premium additions including First Class seats, high-speed Starlink Wi-Fi, in-seat power in the first eight rows of every aircraft, and more.”

Frontier Airlines is on a mission to prove that travel can be both low cost and high value, and has introduced premium product and customer service offerings while maintaining its signature affordable fares. First Class seats and Premium seats with extra-legroom are now being implemented across the airline’s fleet, with reservations open for travel starting March 5, 2027. Additional enhancements, including high-speed Starlink Wi-Fi and in-seat power in the first eight rows of every aircraft will begin rolling out in 2027, further upgrading the onboard experience.


Frontier continues to innovate with its industry-leading frequent flyer program, **Frontier Miles** ,


** which allows members to earn miles and points quickly and get rewarded for each dollar spent on Frontier products. For the 2026 year, Elite status is attainable at only 10,000 points and offers perks such as priority boarding and free bag(s) depending on status level. Like the airline, Frontier Miles is also family friendly, offering easy family pooling of miles for Elite members and making it simple for families to enjoy rewards together.


[Joining is free](https://www.flyfrontier.com/myfrontier/frontier-miles?mobile=true) .


***About the Promotional Fare Offer:**


Tickets must be purchased by 11:59 pm Eastern time on Nov. 26, 2026. Sale fares are valid for non-stop travel on select days of the week, Jan. 5, 2027, through Mar. 3, 2027. The following travel blackout dates apply: Jan. 15-19, 2027; Feb. 11-16, 2027. 21-day advance purchase is required. Not all markets are available for all dates of travel. Round trip purchase is not required. All travel rules will apply, including Frontier Airlines'


[Contract of Carriage](https://www.flyfrontier.com/legal/contract-of-carriage) .
